values.title: Terminal proton/electron complete precision comparison
values.statement: The sealed target-free terminal composite dressing is compared with the complete NIST CODATA proton/electron value and standard uncertainty, while the earlier non-overlap and observational provenance remain preserved.

values.exact_result: The target-free terminal proton/electron algebraic enclosure is wholly contained inside the complete registered CODATA one-standard-uncertainty interval.
values.induction_base: The source row retains its exact central value, standard uncertainty and sealed prediction enclosure.
values.induction_step: Every refinement narrows the same algebraic root enclosure; it cannot change the law, source row, uncertainty or earlier adverse receipt.

values.falsification_condition: The sealed prediction enclosure leaves the complete registered CODATA interval, any uncertainty or adverse receipt is omitted, the target enters the relation, or observational provenance is hidden.
